reason: I'd sign up for the free plan and run it on a few pages to see what it does to my speed and design. I only pay when a limit forces me, and I won't hit 100 conversations in the first month if I start small.
objection: Will it slow down my site or clash with my design? A 30 KB script is fine on paper, but I want to see it on my own store before I trust it. An AI that adds to cart and fills forms also worries me if it gets something wrong.
would_change_my_mind: A free test on my own store showing a measured lift in sales and no hit to page speed, and then the free cap running out because the chat is actually busy.
